select * from tb_material
AND ( material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR spec_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR package_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')

AND warehouse_code = #{warehouse}

ORDER BY CASE WHEN material_code = #{keyword} OR material_name = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN material_code LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR material_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
